parts.script:
Anna: Hey Mark, have you finished preparing your pieces for the art exhibition this weekend?  
Mark: Almost! I just have to add the final touches to a few of them. What about you?  
Anna: I’m done with my paintings, but I need to frame them. I want them to look professional.  
Mark: That’s a good idea! Are you using the same frames as last year?  
Anna: No, I decided to go for a more modern look this time. What theme are you going with?  
Mark: I’m focusing on nature this year. I have some stunning landscapes and a couple of floral pieces.  
Anna: Sounds beautiful! Are you displaying all your works in one area or scattered throughout the venue?  
Mark: I think I’ll group them together. It’ll create a nice flow for viewers.  
Anna: That makes sense. Have you thought about your artist statement?  
Mark: Yes, I’m working on it. I want to convey my inspiration clearly.  
Anna: That’s important! I should get on mine too.  
Mark: Let’s meet up tomorrow to discuss our ideas.  
Anna: Great idea, see you then!
